configurePresets.description: The release build (ship-bob versioning-and-provenance.md): universal on macOS, /MT and /arch:SSE4.2 on Windows, LTO, symbols kept beside the binary (dSYM, PDB) and the shipped binary stripped.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: The plugin and HorizonPadSoundTool built with -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer (HORIZON_ASAN), for the Tier P release gate's sanitizer run. RelWithDebInfo, arm64 only (local dev machine), no LTO (not a Release config), no dSYM/strip step (HORIZON_RELEASE_SYMBOLS stays OFF).
